name: nuclear receptor coactivator 3
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: NCOA3 encodes nuclear receptor coactivator 3. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and histone acetyltransferase activity. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and cell dedifferentiation.
